review.images: The official Manarat Living III corporate page supplies the building and apartment living room. The phase III developer brochure supplies amenity renders. First- and second-phase imagery was excluded.
review.location: The Aldar corporate aerial shows the phase III building and surrounding streets. Bayut’s dedicated Manarat Living III guide gives the three area estimates. Neither source identifies a surveyed entrance.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 22 physical pages of the public Reelly-hosted Aldar plan document. Pages 1–5 show furnished examples and 6–10 provide their technical versions with additional internal labels. Pages 11–22 are the 12 building floorplates. No per-layout whole-home area was assigned.

unavailable: Verified entrance coordinates and signed drawing-specific total areas.
